summary:
Two small admission rules in FS.GG.Coordination reserve capacity for recovery and cap pilot spend.

- SchedulerReservation (Orchestration.fs): available = Capacity - held reservations; recoveryCapacityPreserved holds when paused or when held reservations <= Capacity - RecoveryCapacity. The ordinary-assignment policy uses available - RecoveryCapacity as its slot limit.
- Pilot budget (Pilot.fs, addWithin): an allocation is valid only if the added amount is positive, the current total is nonnegative, the sum cannot overflow int64, and the sum stays within the permit limit. It applies separately to tokens, runtime seconds and cost micro-units, plus a deadline no later than the permit expiry.

These are threshold arithmetic, not library kernels. The reusable rule (cap at the bottleneck, reserve recovery capacity, hold when an input is unknown) is the pack lesson systems/wip-limits-admission. ADR-0098 §11 tranche 2 (FS-GG/.github#5245) lists this record; the generic technique is a pack entry, the FS-GG instance stays here (§10).
title: Recovery-reserve slots and pilot budget admission
